# the rule's state).

		limit = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_levels_under_construction > 0 OR = { building_type = building_type:putrefaction_mill building_type = building_type:putrefaction_works building_type = building_type:saltpeter_workshop building_type = building_type:saltpeter_beds building_type = building_type:saltpeter_guild } } }
		set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_st value = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_level > 0 OR = { building_type = building_type:putrefaction_mill building_type = building_type:putrefaction_works building_type = building_type:saltpeter_workshop building_type = building_type:saltpeter_beds building_type = building_type:saltpeter_guild } } }
		pp_lprof_expand = { type = putrefaction_mill demand = mill_construction cat = std ipl = 0.14 pt = laborers sz = 0.5 }
		pp_lprof_expand = { type = putrefaction_works demand = manufactory_construction cat = std ipl = 0.14 pt = burghers sz = 0.2 }
		pp_lprof_expand = { type = saltpeter_workshop demand = workshop_construction cat = std ipl = 0.14 pt = burghers sz = 0.1 }
		pp_lprof_expand = { type = saltpeter_beds demand = basic_construction_needs cat = std ipl = 0.14 pt = laborers sz = 0.8 }
		pp_lprof_expand = { type = saltpeter_guild demand = guild_construction cat = std ipl = 0.41 pt = burghers sz = 0.1 }
	}
	else = {
		pp_lprof_start = { type = putrefaction_mill demand = mill_construction cat = std ipl = 0.14 pt = laborers sz = 0.5 }
		pp_lprof_start = { type = putrefaction_works demand = manufactory_construction cat = std ipl = 0.14 pt = burghers sz = 0.2 }
		pp_lprof_start = { type = saltpeter_workshop demand = workshop_construction cat = std ipl = 0.14 pt = burghers sz = 0.1 }
		pp_lprof_start = { type = saltpeter_beds demand = basic_construction_needs cat = std ipl = 0.14 pt = laborers sz = 0.8 }
		pp_lprof_start = { type = saltpeter_guild demand = guild_construction cat = std ipl = 0.41 pt = burghers sz = 0.1 }
		pp_lprof_start_pick = yes
	}
}

# Location scope: the building category in the location's variable $v$ (a flag) -> its target.

	switch = {

		flag:government_category = { pp_lprof_t_government_category = yes }
		flag:military_category = { pp_lprof_t_military_category = yes }
		flag:defense_category = { pp_lprof_t_defense_category = yes }
		flag:religious_category = { pp_lprof_t_religious_category = yes }
		flag:cultural_category = { pp_lprof_t_cultural_category = yes }
		flag:naval_category = { pp_lprof_t_naval_category = yes }
		flag:infrastructure_category = { pp_lprof_t_infrastructure_category = yes }
	}
}

# Location scope (in scope:pp_cplan_country's list pp_lprof_locs, owned by it): the rules of its profile in order,
# from the location's copy (pp_lprof_r<r>_*); the first rule that starts a construction ends the location for the
# month. No slot is looked at.
pp_lprof_location_rules = {
	scope:pp_cplan_country = { remove_variable = pp_cplan_hit }
	pp_lprof_rule = { r = 1 }
	pp_lprof_rule = { r = 2 }
	pp_lprof_rule = { r = 3 }
	pp_lprof_rule = { r = 4 }
	pp_lprof_rule = { r = 5 }
	scope:pp_cplan_country = { remove_variable = pp_cplan_hit }
}

# ---- Slots: the only per-slot script ----

# Country scope: pp_lprof_k = the slot (+ 100) of the flag scope:pp_slot (s1..sN, or e = the slot in the edit
# buffer, pp_lprof_e_k); removed for anything else.
pp_lprof_resolve = {
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_k
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_slot = flag:e }
		pp_cplan_copy_num = { from = pp_lprof_e_k to = pp_lprof_k }

	else = {
		switch = {
			trigger = scope:pp_slot

# Country scope: pp_lprof_k = the first slot not in use (removed when all are).
pp_lprof_resolve_free = {
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_k
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_lprof_1_on } } set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_k value = 101 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_lprof_2_on } } set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_k value = 102 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_lprof_3_on } } set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_k value = 103 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_lprof_4_on } } set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_k value = 104 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_lprof_5_on } } set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_k value = 105 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_lprof_6_on } } set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_k value = 106 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_lprof_7_on } } set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_k value = 107 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_lprof_8_on } } set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_k value = 108 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_lprof_9_on } } set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_k value = 109 } }

# The icon or a rule target (scope:pp_field) = the item scope:pp_key (a symbol only as the icon).
pp_lprof_set_staged = {
	switch = {
		trigger = scope:pp_field
		flag:icon = { pp_lprof_set_icon = { g = pp_lprof_s_ig c = pp_lprof_s_ic n = pp_lprof_s_in } }
		flag:r1 = { pp_lprof_set_target = { g = pp_lprof_s_r1_g c = pp_lprof_s_r1_c n = pp_lprof_s_r1_cn } }
		flag:r2 = { pp_lprof_set_target = { g = pp_lprof_s_r2_g c = pp_lprof_s_r2_c n = pp_lprof_s_r2_cn } }
		flag:r3 = { pp_lprof_set_target = { g = pp_lprof_s_r3_g c = pp_lprof_s_r3_c n = pp_lprof_s_r3_cn } }
		flag:r4 = { pp_lprof_set_target = { g = pp_lprof_s_r4_g c = pp_lprof_s_r4_c n = pp_lprof_s_r4_cn } }
		flag:r5 = { pp_lprof_set_target = { g = pp_lprof_s_r5_g c = pp_lprof_s_r5_c n = pp_lprof_s_r5_cn } }
	}
}

# The global rule group scope:pp_field (global_food / ...) switched off in the profile's locations, or on again
# (unset = on: the group builds there too, except the targets of the profile's rules).
pp_lprof_global_staged = {
	switch = {
		trigger = scope:pp_field
		flag:global_food = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pp_lprof_s_xf }
				remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_xf
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_s_xf value = 101 }
			}
		}
		flag:global_logistics = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pp_lprof_s_xl }
				remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_xl
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_s_xl value = 101 }
			}
		}
		flag:global_improve = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pp_lprof_s_xi }
				remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_xi
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_s_xi value = 101 }
			}
		}
		flag:global_business = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pp_lprof_s_xg }
				remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_xg
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_s_xg value = 101 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# The colour scope:pp_col (c1..cN).
pp_lprof_color_staged = {
	switch = {
		trigger = scope:pp_col
		flag:c1 = { set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_s_col value = 101 } }
		flag:c2 = { set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_s_col value = 102 } }
		flag:c3 = { set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_s_col value = 103 } }
		flag:c4 = { set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_s_col value = 104 } }
		flag:c5 = { set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_s_col value = 105 } }
		flag:c6 = { set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_s_col value = 106 } }
		flag:c7 = { set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_s_col value = 107 } }
		flag:c8 = { set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_s_col value = 108 } }
	}
}

# Any scope: steps the payback limit $var$ (years + 100; unset = any) through [location_profiles] payback_steps
# (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 10, 15, 20, 30, 40, 50) in the direction scope:pp_dir; up from the last step = any, down from
# any = the last step, down from the first stays.
pp_lprof_pb_step = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_dir = flag:up }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = $var$ }
			if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 100.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 101 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 101.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 102 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 102.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 103 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 103.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 104 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 104.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 105 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 106.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 107 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 109.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 110 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 114.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 115 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 119.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 120 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 129.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 130 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 139.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 140 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 149.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 150 } }
			else = { remove_variable = $var$ }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = $var$ } }
			set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 150 }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 150.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 150 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 140.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 140 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 130.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 130 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 120.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 120 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 115.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 115 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 110.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 110 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 107.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 107 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 105.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 105 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 104.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 104 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 103.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 103 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 102.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 102 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 101.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 101 } }
	}
}

# The payback limit of rule scope:pp_field (r1..rN), one step in the direction scope:pp_dir.
pp_lprof_payback_staged = {
	switch = {
		trigger = scope:pp_field
		flag:r1 = { pp_lprof_pb_step = { var = pp_lprof_s_r1_pb } }
		flag:r2 = { pp_lprof_pb_step = { var = pp_lprof_s_r2_pb } }
		flag:r3 = { pp_lprof_pb_step = { var = pp_lprof_s_r3_pb } }
		flag:r4 = { pp_lprof_pb_step = { var = pp_lprof_s_r4_pb } }
		flag:r5 = { pp_lprof_pb_step = { var = pp_lprof_s_r5_pb } }
	}
}

# Rule scope:pp_field emptied, and its states in the slot's locations.
pp_lprof_rule_clear_staged = {
	pp_lprof_save_range = yes
	switch = {
		trigger = scope:pp_field
		flag:r1 = {
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_r1_g
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_r1_c
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_r1_cn
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_r1_pb
			every_in_list = {
				variable = pp_lprof_locs
				limit = { has_variable = pp_lprof var:pp_lprof > scope:pp_lprof_lo var:pp_lprof < scope:pp_lprof_hi }
				remove_variable = pp_lprof_r1_st
				remove_variable = pp_lprof_r1_est
			}
		}
		flag:r2 = {
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_r2_g
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_r2_c
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_r2_cn
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_r2_pb
			every_in_list = {
				variable = pp_lprof_locs
				limit = { has_variable = pp_lprof var:pp_lprof > scope:pp_lprof_lo var:pp_lprof < scope:pp_lprof_hi }
				remove_variable = pp_lprof_r2_st
				remove_variable = pp_lprof_r2_est
			}
		}
		flag:r3 = {
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_r3_g
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_r3_c
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_r3_cn
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_r3_pb
			every_in_list = {
				variable = pp_lprof_locs
				limit = { has_variable = pp_lprof var:pp_lprof > scope:pp_lprof_lo var:pp_lprof < scope:pp_lprof_hi }
				remove_variable = pp_lprof_r3_st
				remove_variable = pp_lprof_r3_est
			}
		}
		flag:r4 = {
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_r4_g
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_r4_c
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_r4_cn
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_r4_pb
			every_in_list = {
				variable = pp_lprof_locs
				limit = { has_variable = pp_lprof var:pp_lprof > scope:pp_lprof_lo var:pp_lprof < scope:pp_lprof_hi }
				remove_variable = pp_lprof_r4_st
				remove_variable = pp_lprof_r4_est
			}
		}
		flag:r5 = {
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_r5_g
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_r5_c
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_r5_cn
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_s_r5_pb
			every_in_list = {
				variable = pp_lprof_locs
				limit = { has_variable = pp_lprof var:pp_lprof > scope:pp_lprof_lo var:pp_lprof < scope:pp_lprof_hi }
				remove_variable = pp_lprof_r5_st
				remove_variable = pp_lprof_r5_est
			}
		}
	}
}

# Rule scope:pp_field swaps places with its neighbour in the direction scope:pp_dir.
pp_lprof_rule_move_staged = {
	switch = {
		trigger = scope:pp_field
		flag:r1 = {
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_dir = flag:down }
				pp_lprof_swap_rules = { a = 1 b = 2 }
			}
		}
		flag:r2 = {
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_dir = flag:up }
				pp_lprof_swap_rules = { a = 1 b = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_dir = flag:down }
				pp_lprof_swap_rules = { a = 2 b = 3 }
			}
		}
		flag:r3 = {
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_dir = flag:up }
				pp_lprof_swap_rules = { a = 2 b = 3 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_dir = flag:down }
				pp_lprof_swap_rules = { a = 3 b = 4 }
			}
		}
		flag:r4 = {
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_dir = flag:up }
				pp_lprof_swap_rules = { a = 3 b = 4 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_dir = flag:down }
				pp_lprof_swap_rules = { a = 4 b = 5 }
			}
		}
		flag:r5 = {
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_dir = flag:up }
				pp_lprof_swap_rules = { a = 4 b = 5 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---- Copies of a profile ----

# Any scope (scope:pp_lprof_country = the profile's country): scope:pp_lprof_country's $from$_* -> this scope's
# $to$_* (icon with its frame number, colour, rules; what $from$ lacks goes). A slot is pp_lprof_<k>, the staged
# copy pp_lprof_s, the edit buffer pp_lprof_e (country), a location's copy pp_lprof. The rules' category frame
# numbers (drawn only in the editor) go separately: pp_lprof_copy_frames.
pp_lprof_copy_profile = {
	pp_lprof_pull_g = { from = $from$_ig to = $to$_ig }
	pp_lprof_pull_icon = { from = $from$_ic to = $to$_ic }
	pp_lprof_pull_n = { from = $from$_in to = $to$_in }
	pp_lprof_pull_n = { from = $from$_col to = $to$_col }
	pp_lprof_pull_g = { from = $from$_r1_g to = $to$_r1_g }
	pp_lprof_pull_cat = { from = $from$_r1_c to = $to$_r1_c }
	pp_lprof_pull_n = { from = $from$_r1_pb to = $to$_r1_pb }
	pp_lprof_pull_g = { from = $from$_r2_g to = $to$_r2_g }
	pp_lprof_pull_cat = { from = $from$_r2_c to = $to$_r2_c }
	pp_lprof_pull_n = { from = $from$_r2_pb to = $to$_r2_pb }
	pp_lprof_pull_g = { from = $from$_r3_g to = $to$_r3_g }
	pp_lprof_pull_cat = { from = $from$_r3_c to = $to$_r3_c }
	pp_lprof_pull_n = { from = $from$_r3_pb to = $to$_r3_pb }
	pp_lprof_pull_g = { from = $from$_r4_g to = $to$_r4_g }
	pp_lprof_pull_cat = { from = $from$_r4_c to = $to$_r4_c }
	pp_lprof_pull_n = { from = $from$_r4_pb to = $to$_r4_pb }
	pp_lprof_pull_g = { from = $from$_r5_g to = $to$_r5_g }
	pp_lprof_pull_cat = { from = $from$_r5_c to = $to$_r5_c }
	pp_lprof_pull_n = { from = $from$_r5_pb to = $to$_r5_pb }
	pp_lprof_pull_n = { from = $from$_xf to = $to$_xf }
	pp_lprof_pull_n = { from = $from$_xl to = $to$_xl }
	pp_lprof_pull_n = { from = $from$_xi to = $to$_xi }
	pp_lprof_pull_n = { from = $from$_xg to = $to$_xg }
}

# Any scope: the frame numbers of the rules' category targets, scope:pp_lprof_country's $from$_* -> this scope's
# $to$_* (slots, the staged copy, the edit buffer; a location's copy needs none).
pp_lprof_copy_frames = {
	pp_lprof_pull_n = { from = $from$_r1_cn to = $to$_r1_cn }
	pp_lprof_pull_n = { from = $from$_r2_cn to = $to$_r2_cn }
	pp_lprof_pull_n = { from = $from$_r3_cn to = $to$_r3_cn }
	pp_lprof_pull_n = { from = $from$_r4_cn to = $to$_r4_cn }
	pp_lprof_pull_n = { from = $from$_r5_cn to = $to$_r5_cn }
}

# Any scope: a copy of a profile ($p$_*) removed. The rules' frame numbers exist only on slots, the staged copy
# and the edit buffer (pp_lprof_clear_frames): removing a variable never set counts as a use, and on a location
# copy logged "used but never set" (in game 2026-11-07).
pp_lprof_clear_copies = {
	remove_variable = $p$_ig
	remove_variable = $p$_ic
	remove_variable = $p$_in
	remove_variable = $p$_col
	remove_variable = $p$_r1_g
	remove_variable = $p$_r1_c
	remove_variable = $p$_r1_pb
	remove_variable = $p$_r2_g
	remove_variable = $p$_r2_c
	remove_variable = $p$_r2_pb
	remove_variable = $p$_r3_g
	remove_variable = $p$_r3_c
	remove_variable = $p$_r3_pb
	remove_variable = $p$_r4_g
	remove_variable = $p$_r4_c
	remove_variable = $p$_r4_pb
	remove_variable = $p$_r5_g
	remove_variable = $p$_r5_c
	remove_variable = $p$_r5_pb
	remove_variable = $p$_xf
	remove_variable = $p$_xl
	remove_variable = $p$_xi
	remove_variable = $p$_xg
}

# Any scope but a location: the rules' frame numbers of a copy ($p$_*) removed.
pp_lprof_clear_frames = {
	remove_variable = $p$_r1_cn
	remove_variable = $p$_r2_cn
	remove_variable = $p$_r3_cn
	remove_variable = $p$_r4_cn
	remove_variable = $p$_r5_cn
}

# Location scope: removes the rule states and the payback notes.
pp_lprof_clear_states = {
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_r1_st
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_r1_est
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_r2_st
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_r2_est
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_r3_st
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_r3_est
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_r4_st
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_r4_est
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_r5_st
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_r5_est
}

# Any scope: the icon (a building category or a symbol) flag in scope:pp_lprof_country's variable $from$ -> this scope's $to$ (removed when
# $from$ holds none). A switch: the flag is compared, never copied as a value.
pp_lprof_pull_icon = {
	remove_variable = $to$
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_lprof_country = { has_variable = $from$ } }
		switch = {
			trigger = scope:pp_lprof_country.var:$from$
			flag:trade_category = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:trade_category } }
			flag:government_category = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:government_category } }
			flag:military_category = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:military_category } }
			flag:defense_category = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:defense_category } }
			flag:religious_category = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:religious_category } }
			flag:cultural_category = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:cultural_category } }
			flag:naval_category = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:naval_category } }
			flag:infrastructure_category = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:infrastructure_category } }
			flag:pp_sym_city = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:pp_sym_city } }
			flag:pp_sym_town = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:pp_sym_town } }
			flag:pp_sym_village = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:pp_sym_village } }
			flag:pp_sym_capital = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:pp_sym_capital } }
			flag:pp_sym_food = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:pp_sym_food } }
			flag:pp_sym_farming = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:pp_sym_farming } }
			flag:pp_sym_herding = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:pp_sym_herding } }
			flag:pp_sym_fishing = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:pp_sym_fishing } }
			flag:pp_sym_forest = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:pp_sym_forest } }
			flag:pp_sym_mining = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:pp_sym_mining } }
			flag:pp_sym_industry = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:pp_sym_industry } }
			flag:pp_sym_luxury = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:pp_sym_luxury } }
			flag:pp_sym_market = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:pp_sym_market } }
			flag:pp_sym_treasury = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:pp_sym_treasury } }
			flag:pp_sym_harbour = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:pp_sym_harbour } }
			flag:pp_sym_military = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:pp_sym_military } }
			flag:pp_sym_stronghold = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:pp_sym_stronghold } }
			flag:pp_sym_religion = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:pp_sym_religion } }
			flag:pp_sym_learning = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:pp_sym_learning } }
			flag:pp_sym_administration = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:pp_sym_administration } }
			flag:pp_sym_population = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:pp_sym_population } }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope: the building category flag in scope:pp_lprof_country's variable $from$ -> this scope's $to$ (removed when
# $from$ holds none). A switch: the flag is compared, never copied as a value.
pp_lprof_pull_cat = {
	remove_variable = $to$

		limit = { scope:pp_lprof_country = { has_variable = $from$ } }

			trigger = scope:pp_lprof_country.var:$from$

			flag:military_category = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:military_category } }
			flag:defense_category = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:defense_category } }
			flag:religious_category = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:religious_category } }
			flag:cultural_category = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:cultural_category } }
			flag:naval_category = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:naval_category } }
			flag:infrastructure_category = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:infrastructure_category } }
		}
	}
}

		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_key value = flag:iron }
		pp_lprof_set_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_dir value = flag:down }
		pp_lprof_payback_do = yes
		pp_lprof_payback_do = yes
		pp_lprof_payback_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_field value = flag:r2 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_key value = flag:copper }
		pp_lprof_set_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_dir value = flag:down }
		pp_lprof_payback_do = yes
		pp_lprof_payback_do = yes
		pp_lprof_payback_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_field value = flag:r3 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_key value = flag:lead }
		pp_lprof_set_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_dir value = flag:down }
		pp_lprof_payback_do = yes
		pp_lprof_payback_do = yes
		pp_lprof_payback_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_field value = flag:r4 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_key value = flag:tin }
		pp_lprof_set_do = yes

		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_field value = flag:icon }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_key value = flag:pp_sym_market }
		pp_lprof_set_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_col value = flag:c3 }
		pp_lprof_color_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_field value = flag:r1 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_key value = flag:logistics }
		pp_lprof_set_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_field value = flag:r2 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_key value = flag:trade_category }
		pp_lprof_set_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_dir value = flag:down }
		pp_lprof_payback_do = yes
		pp_lprof_payback_do = yes
		pp_lprof_payback_do = yes
		pp_lprof_payback_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_field value = flag:r3 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_key value = flag:tools }
		pp_lprof_set_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_dir value = flag:down }
		pp_lprof_payback_do = yes
		pp_lprof_payback_do = yes
		pp_lprof_payback_do = yes
		pp_lprof_payback_do = yes
	}
	# example 5: pp_sym_harbour
	if = {
		limit = { pp_lprof_first_free > 0 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_slot value = flag:next }
		pp_lprof_new_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_slot value = flag:e }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_field value = flag:icon }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_key value = flag:pp_sym_harbour }
		pp_lprof_set_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_col value = flag:c6 }
		pp_lprof_color_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_field value = flag:r1 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_key value = flag:fish }
		pp_lprof_set_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_dir value = flag:down }
		pp_lprof_payback_do = yes
		pp_lprof_payback_do = yes
		pp_lprof_payback_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_field value = flag:r2 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_key value = flag:naval_category }
		pp_lprof_set_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_dir value = flag:down }
		pp_lprof_payback_do = yes
		pp_lprof_payback_do = yes
		pp_lprof_payback_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_field value = flag:r3 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_key value = flag:logistics }
		pp_lprof_set_do = yes
	}
	# example 6: pp_sym_stronghold
	if = {
		limit = { pp_lprof_first_free > 0 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_slot value = flag:next }
		pp_lprof_new_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_slot value = flag:e }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_field value = flag:icon }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_key value = flag:pp_sym_stronghold }
		pp_lprof_set_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_col value = flag:c7 }
		pp_lprof_color_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_field value = flag:global_food }
		pp_lprof_global_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_field value = flag:global_logistics }
		pp_lprof_global_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_field value = flag:global_improve }
		pp_lprof_global_do = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = pp_field value = flag:global_business }
		pp_lprof_global_do = yes
	}
}
